messages:
marta: Heads up — deploybot moved v2 -> 10% EU traffic at 10:15 UTC and we're seeing a small surge in streaming tail latency.

deploybot: deploybot: traffic shift: v2=10% (routes: /generate, /chat) region=eu timestamp=2026-03-21T10:15:00Z

raj: getting a handful of `incomplete-chunk` errors from mobile SDKs, correlates with the v2 traffic window.

eli: tail latency on gpu-pool-3 is up; p95 ~600ms -> p95 ~1.1s, p99 up more. Sequence lengths spiked for a few tenants.

sam: can we pin the top offending tenants back to v1 while we triage? quick isolation.

marta: yes — sounds sensible. Raj, which tenants are highest error volume?

raj: tenant-78 and tenant-101 are ~60% of the errors, then a long tail.

marta: i'm adding `tenant-78` and `tenant-101` to pinlist now — command: `/deploy pin tenant-78 tenant-101 --reason "v2 streaming tail"`

deploybot: deploybot: pinned tenants: tenant-78 tenant-101. Routing for those tenants reverted to v1 immediately.

eli: after pin, tenant-specific latency for those improved to baseline, overall streaming still ~8% higher than pre-rollout.

sam: looks like the new async flush behavior in v2 streaming path (merged last night) is the suspect.

marta: Ops decision: pause further ramp. Hold canary at 10% and don't promote until we have a hotfix.

raj: i'll open a hotfix PR to revert the flush change and add a simple integration probebuild. ETA ~45m.

marta: update release notes to mention streaming is opt-in and we had to pin some tenants as a precaution. Also add rollback entry.

sam: i'll ping partner-integrations and mobile channels — let them know two tenants were pinned and we're investigating.

eli: set temporary alert: streaming p99 tokens > 1.2s -> page. If p99 > 1.5s for 15m we do a full rollback across regions.

marta: agreed. if the hotfix doesn't land cleanly we should be ready to roll v2 back entirely.

deploybot: deploybot: canary paused at 10% per operator marta request.

raj: hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 — reverting `async-stream-flush` change + extra unit.

sam: monitoring dashboards and mobile logs. i'll report if we see any secondary spikes.

marta: thanks — keep comms here. i'll draft the short release note patch and post to #partner-integrations. :thumbsup:
